meta.name: autoskill
meta.description: Observe the user's screen via screenpipe, detect repeated research workflows, match them against existing scientific-agent-skills, and draft new skills (or composition recipes that chain existing ones) for the patterns not yet covered. Use when the user asks to analyze their recent work and propose skills based on what they actually do. Requires the screenpipe daemon (https://github.com/screenpipe/screenpipe) running locally on port 3030 — the skill has no other data source and will refuse to run if screenpipe is unreachable. All detection runs locally; only redacted cluster summaries reach the LLM.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据屏幕操作自动生成新技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常做重复研究操作，想自动生成技能来提速。
copy.tagline_en: Auto-generate skills from your screen activity
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often repeat research steps and want skills to automate them.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会通过本地 screenpipe 服务观察你的屏幕操作，识别重复的研究工作流程，并与已有的技能匹配。对于未覆盖的模式，它会草拟新技能或组合现有技能的方案。
howto.when: 当你要求分析最近的工作并提出新技能时触发，例如“分析我过去4小时的工作”或“看看我重复的操作”。需要本地运行 screenpipe 守护进程（端口3030）。

say.text: 分析我过去一天的工作，提出新技能。
看看我最近重复的操作，哪些还没有技能覆盖。
say.note: Claude 会匹配现有技能并报告未覆盖的模式。

say.text: 为我的文献管理流程草拟一个新技能。
say.note: Claude 会生成一个 SKILL.md 文件供你审查。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude observes your screen via the local screenpipe service, detects repeated research workflows, matches them against existing skills, and drafts new skills or composition recipes for uncovered patterns.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to analyze recent work and propose skills, e.g., 'analyze my last 4 hours' or 'find what's not covered'. Requires the screenpipe daemon running locally on port 3030.

say_en.text: Analyze my last day of work and propose new skills.
say_en.note: Claude will fetch data from screenpipe and generate skill proposals.

say_en.text: Check my recent repeated actions and see what skills are missing.
say_en.note: Claude will match against existing skills and report uncovered patterns.

say_en.text: Draft a new skill for my literature management workflow.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a SKILL.md file for your review.
